abstract: The influence of methotrexate (MTX), dibutyryl cyclic AMP, and actinomycin D on production of human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) in normal first trimester human placental organ cultures was compared. Actinomycin D (10(-8) to 10(-6) M) elevated HCG production by as much as 3.5-fold in normal placenta, and a 2-fold increase in HCG levels was obtained by treatment with dibutyryl cyclic AMP (1 mM) and theophylline (1 mM). The combination of dibutyryl cyclic AMP (1 mM) plus theophylline (1 mM) and actinomycin D (10(-8) M) additively enhanced HCG production by 4.5-fold. In contrast, HCG levels in normal placental organ cultures were unaffected by MTX (10(-8) to 10(-5) M) despite several differing treatment regimens. The JAr line of human choriocarcinoma cells, on the other hand, exhibited an 8-fold increase in HCG levels following MTX exposure (10(-7) M). Incorporation of selected radiolabeled precursors of the de novo and salvage pathways of DNA synthesis was evaluated to assess potential metabolic alterations underlying the differential HCG response of these cultures to MTX. Deoxyuridine incorporation into DNA was decreased similarly in both normal and malignant placenta following MTX exposure. However, deoxycytidine incorporation was inhibited by MTX in normal placental cultures but was elevated by as much as 4-fold in JAr cultures exposed to MTX. Thymidine incorporation into DNA was increased in both groups in the presence of MTX; however, thymidine incorporation was more profoundly stimulated (5-fold) in normal placenta than in JAr cultures (2.5-fold). These data indicate dissimilar utilization of the de novo and salvage pathways of DNA synthesis by these cultures which may explain their differential responsiveness to MTX.
abstract_ja: 正常な妊娠初期のヒト胎盤器官培養において、メトトレキサート(MTX)、ジブチリル環状AMP、アクチノマイシンDのヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生への影響を比較した。アクチノマイシンD(10^-8～10^-6 M)は正常胎盤でhCG産生を最大3.5倍に上昇させ、ジブチリル環状AMP(1 mM)とテオフィリン(1 mM)の処理でhCG量は2倍に増加した。ジブチリル環状AMP(1 mM)とテオフィリン(1 mM)の併用にアクチノマイシンD(10^-8 M)を加えると、hCG産生は相加的に4.5倍に増強された。対照的に、正常胎盤器官培養のhCG量は、複数の異なる処理条件でもMTX(10^-8～10^-5 M)による影響を受けなかった。一方、ヒト絨毛癌JAr細胞株では、MTX(10^-7 M)暴露後にhCG量が8倍に増加した。MTXに対する両培養物の異なる応答を説明しうる代謝変化を評価するため、DNA合成のde novo経路およびsalvage経路の選択された放射標識前駆体の取り込みを検討した。MTX暴露後、デオキシウリジンのDNAへの取り込みは正常胎盤と悪性胎盤の両方で同様に低下した。しかし、デオキシシチジンの取り込みは正常胎盤培養ではMTXにより阻害されたが、JAr培養ではMTX暴露後に最大4倍に上昇した。チミジンのDNAへの取り込みは両群でMTX存在下に増加したが、その増加は正常胎盤（5倍）でJAr（2.5倍）より顕著であった。これらのデータは、両培養がDNA合成のde novo経路とsalvage経路を異なる形で利用していることを示しており、それがMTXへの異なる応答性を説明しうる。
